_comment: The generated title index already covers Sefaria's own heTitle plus mechanical
aliases (a leading 'משנה'/'מסכת' is dropped, gershayim/geresh/quotes are removed).
Add an entry here ONLY after checking the real name against library.getTree in a
running Otzaria - see docs/MAPPING.md and reports/coverage.md.
byOtzariaTitle : Otzaria book title (as returned by library.getTree) -> Sefaria work title
aliases        : Sefaria work title -> extra titles that should resolve to it
excludedOtzariaTitles : Otzaria titles to never map (e.g. a PDF facsimile of the same work)
